mapper.select: select * from where deleted = 0 and BINARY word = #{word}
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ( `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY , `word` VARCHAR( 255 ) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL , `sentences` LONGTEXT CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL , `deleted` INT( 2 ) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `createtime` DATETIME NOT NULL , `updatetime` TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , INDEX ( `word` , `deleted` , `updatetime` ) ) ENGINE = INNODB CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci;
